title: Ordinary strict scalar association of quotient complexes
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L and a scheme W. Let A be extension data and let association satisfy the balanced formula [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data]. Let M be an ordinary E-quotient tensor model [def-trf-completion-unit-models]. Suppose rho is an ordinary scalar-evaluation comparison respecting the ordinary units [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation]. Let direct be a functor from good completed-E complexes to complexes of L-coefficient systems, with directEvaluation and the prescribed strict successor transitions. Then applying M.quotient followed by the ordinary system scalar functor termwise is naturally isomorphic to direct. Its finite chain evaluation followed by directEvaluation equals rho followed by finite scalar extension of M.evaluation and the given termwise association. This is an assertion in ordinary categories of complexes; it involves no derived system comparison or reduction calculus.

source.place: sites-modules.tex, lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7) and section-tensor-product (03EK); sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok (0941); step 3 of stage3-pur-extension-strict-derived-comparison.

proof.text: At each finite level form the natural isomorphism a_n from rho after M.tensor, finite scalar extension of M.evaluation, and balanced association. Apply this ordinary module isomorphism in every cochain degree. Its naturality gives the differential and input-naturality squares. Compose with directEvaluation inverse to obtain the finite source-to-direct isomorphisms.

The local tensor successor theorem identifies the source successor in the a_n coordinates with integralScalarTransition. The supplied htransition identifies the direct successor with that same map in directEvaluation coordinates. Evaluate both on an arbitrary local section, substitute the two identities and cancel the finite isomorphisms. Module-sheaf extensionality gives the successor compatibility square.

On the product site, use induction on m-n to prove all horizontal compatibility squares from the successor squares. A general product-site morphism factors as a horizontal arrow followed by a same-level site arrow; finite-map naturality gives the other square. The evaluation scalar maps are isomorphisms, hence surjective on sections, so the component maps are linear over the sequence ring itself. Assemble their module isomorphisms into a presheaf isomorphism and lift it through the fully faithful sheaf-module forgetful functor. Evaluation at each pair (n,U) determines a system map. Thus the degreewise isomorphisms commute with differentials and assemble naturally in the input complex, constructing beta with its prescribed finite maps.

The finite evaluation of beta is a_n followed by directEvaluation inverse, by construction. Cancel directEvaluation inverse followed by directEvaluation. Degreewise projection of the remaining composite is exactly rho followed by finite scalar extension of M.evaluation and coefficientExtensionAssociationChain, proving the stated equation without changing its signature.

proof_origin.place: 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex section-derived-limits preceding 0941. Explicit Lean construction of all ordinary system, cochain and functor isomorphisms; the source tensor successor calculation is isolated in stage3-pur-extension-association-successor. Product-site gluing adapts the private proved helpers of Sheaf.Paper.TransportedReductionPullbackNormalized, with successor induction added.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientExtensionOrdinaryAssociationChain
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (hρ : IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι W A ρ)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
        integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι W A association)
    (direct : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory ⥤
      CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L W) ℤ)
    (directEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
      direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n)
    (htransition : IsCoefficientExtensionStrictTransition l E L ι W direct directEvaluation) :
    letI := coefficientScalarModelZero A.scalar
    ∃ β : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ M.quotient l E W ⋙
        A.scalar.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅ direct,
      ∀ (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
        letI := coefficientExtensionSystemEvaluationZero l E L ι W A n
        letI := coefficientExtensionEvaluationFiniteZero l E L ι W A n
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
              (β.hom.app P) ≫ (directEvaluation n).hom.app P =
          (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (ρ n) (.up ℤ)).hom.app
              ((M.quotient l E W).obj P.obj) ≫
            ((A.levels n).model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
              ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P.obj) ≫
            coefficientExtensionAssociationChain l E L ι W A n (association n) P.obj
